tools.name: shield.request_purchase
tools.description: Ask the user's Shield for ALLOW, ASK, or BLOCK before a purchase executes.

tools.name: shield.check_spending_authority
tools.description: Preview authority for an amount and spender without executing the action.

tools.name: shield.get_permission
tools.description: Read the user's permission for the calling registered app or agent.

tools.name: shield.request_approval
tools.description: Start Presence approval for an ASK decision; the action remains on hold.

tools.name: shield.get_decision
tools.description: Read the current state and dossier reference for a prior decision.

safety.allow: The agent may execute only the exact authorized action once.
safety.ask: The agent must hold and request approval.
safety.error: A tool or transport error is not permission to execute.
